about.rateMax: Very high rates: a character is ready for PvP almost at once.

account.title: Account
account.intro: Sign in to add your server to MMOTOP and manage it. Enter your email and we will send you a sign-in link — no password needed.
account.sent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}.
account.sentHint: Open it on this device. If the email is not there, check the spam folder.
account.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please try again in an hour.
account.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
account.noServers: You have no servers yet. Add the first one — it appears on the site once a moderator approves it.
account.recheck: After changes to a listed server, it goes back to moderation.
account.moderation: Every new server and every change is checked by a moderator before it appears on the site.
account.idTaken: This address is already taken. Choose another.
account.invalid: Some fields are filled in incorrectly. Please check them.

fields.name: Server name
fields.idHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, 3–32 characters.
fields.imageTooBig: The picture is too large even after shrinking; try a smaller one.
fields.imageFailed: The picture could not be uploaded. Please try again.
fields.logoReview: The new logo will appear on the site after review.

account.savedReview: Your server has been sent for review. It usually takes up to a day.

reward.title: Reward for voting
reward.on: Give a reward for a vote
reward.hint: Players enter their nickname when they vote; the site tells your server at once, and the server gives the reward.
reward.secretHint: Every notification is signed with it, so your server can check it comes from MMOTOP.
reward.afterSave: The key will appear here once the server is saved.
reward.testHint: Sends the address a request with the nickname TEST, to check the script on your server without voting. Your settings are saved first.
reward.testBad: The server answered {status} — the notification was not accepted.
reward.testNone: The server did not answer within 5 seconds.
reward.testSoon: Wait a few seconds and try again.
reward.listHint: Your server can fetch who voted from here by itself: one line per vote, “number;time;nickname”, for the last 24 hours. Add &since=the number of the last vote you handled to get only new ones. Then the notification address can stay empty.
reward.urlOptional: (not needed if your server fetches the vote list)
reward.exampleList: Download an example for the vote list (PHP, run on a schedule)

signin.codeHint: Open the email on your phone and enter the code from it here — no need to open your mail on this computer.
signin.codeWrong: The code didn’t work or has expired. Request a new one.
signin.notMine: Someone else’s computer — don’t stay signed in
signin.qr: Sign in with a QR code from your phone
signin.qrScan: Scan the code with a phone where you’re already signed in to your account, and confirm.
signin.approveText: Allow signing in to your account on another device? Check the code matches the one on its screen: {code}
signin.approveDone: Done: that device is signed in.
signin.approveExpired: This QR code has expired. Refresh it on that device.
signin.approveSignIn: Sign in here to allow the sign-in on the other device.
signin.telegramFailed: Couldn’t sign in with Telegram. Please try again.
signin.telegramHint: Link Telegram to sign in with it on any computer.
signin.telegramLinked: Telegram is linked — you can sign in with it.
signin.telegramTaken: This Telegram is already linked to another account.

settings.title: Account
settings.emailSent: We sent confirmation emails to your old and new addresses. The email changes once you confirm both.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete your account and all your servers ({n})? Their votes go too. This can’t be undone.
settings.deleteLastAdmin: The only admin can’t be deleted: appoint another one first.
settings.unlinkConfirm: Unlink {name}? You won’t be able to sign in with it until you link it again.
settings.onlyWay: This is the only way into the account, so it can’t be unlinked.
settings.howLink: Google and Discord link by themselves when you sign in with them using the account’s email.
settings.addEmailHint: Until the account has an email, it can only be signed into with Telegram. With one, you can sign in by email, Google and Discord too.
settings.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. Enter it below.
settings.taken: This email already belongs to another account.
settings.added: Email added. You can sign in with it now.
settings.wait: You can ask for a new code in a minute.

vote.nicknameHint: If the server rewards votes, the reward goes to this character.
vote.thanks: Thank you! Your vote counts. You can vote again in 12 hours.
vote.thanksRewarded: Thank you! Your vote counts, and the server has been told about your reward. You can vote again in 12 hours.
vote.tooSoon: You have already voted for this server. You can vote again: {time}.
vote.badNickname: A nickname is 2–32 letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores.
vote.captchaFailed: The check did not pass. Please try again.
vote.captchaLoad: The check could not load. Reload the page and try again.
vote.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
